sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Uncensored: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-Uncensored is a GGUF-quantized version of Qwen 3.5's 9-billion parameter model maintained by LEONW24, designed for local deployment without safety filters. The model uses Q4_K_M quantization, resulting in a 6.3 GB file size while retaining the original Qwen 3.5 architecture's 131,072-token context window and multilingual capabilities (English, Chinese, and other languages ...
